name: aurora-chat-block
title: Aurora Interactive Chat
author: jmagar <https://github.com/jmagar>
description: Interactive Aurora chat workspace combining the new conversation primitives with steerable streaming, editable user turns, hover actions, code and source surfaces, model/reasoning selection, slash-command skills, file mentions, and an in-field composer.
docs:
Aurora interactive chat workspace composed from MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Chat Attachment, and Marker plus Aurora's existing developer surfaces. Assistant turns are unbubbled; timestamps and message actions reveal on hover/focus; user turns support edit; assistant actions group icon-only copy, retry, and thumbs-up. The local demo includes steerable streaming, Stop vs Send behavior, model and reasoning selectors, slash-command skills, file @mentions, compact code blocks/snippets, sources/references, mock attachment lifecycle, and jump controls.

Registry dependencies: aurora-tokens, aurora-components, aurora-button, aurora-spinner, aurora-textarea, aurora-select, aurora-message-scroller, aurora-message, aurora-bubble, aurora-chat-attachment, aurora-marker, aurora-code-block, aurora-ai-snippet, aurora-ai-sources.
